description: EPA AirNow air quality (AQI) forecast for a US ZIP code — today and up to three days ahead, per pollutant, with the forecast category, Action Day flag and the forecaster's discussion text. Pass a date (YYYY-MM-DD) to get one day, omit it for every day AirNow has issued. Answers "is tomorrow ok for outdoor activity in 60601".

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD forecast day (default: every day AirNow has issued, today + up to 3)

distance_miles.description: Search radius for the nearest reporting area (default 25, max 250)

name: forecast_by_zip
